title: Home — Content

fields.message: Home — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_home_hero_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: brg_home_hero_cta_label
fields.instructions: The wording on the hero button. Short reads best — it sits under the tagline.

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: brg_home_hero_cta_href
fields.instructions: Where the hero button goes. A path like /brands/ stays on this site; a full address goes off it.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_home_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero headline. PRESS RETURN where you want the line to break — it breaks exactly there. Two lines is the design; three starts eating the fold on a phone.
fields.default_value:
We're in the business
of making your day great.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_home_hero_sub
fields.instructions: Sits under the marker underline, capped at 52ch. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write & and — as literal characters. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.
fields.default_value: From a classic Board & Brew sandwich to a slice at Odie's — we're here for the moments that matter.

fields.label: Yellow tagline
fields.name: brg_home_hero_tagline
fields.instructions: The short line beneath the sub, in the display face. White, not yellow, per the comp. ~40 characters.
fields.default_value: Good food. Real people. Rad experience.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_home_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe — keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback with no skewed edge to overhang. u1 scaleX bar, the lab's baseline, kept so the taper argument can be re-checked live. Unknown or blank renders the mark STATIC and visible, never hidden. u2/u4 (dasharray draws) need the artwork inline as SVG and are not available on an . Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: brg_home_hero_bg_photo
fields.instructions: The full-bleed hero collage behind the logo and headline. Dark imagery works best — the headline and sub copy sit on top in white. Landscape, at least 1600px wide. Leave empty to keep the current picture.

fields.label: Background photo — phones
fields.name: brg_home_hero_bg_photo_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the hero photo for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave empty and the main photo above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main photo is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or tighter version reads far better.

fields.label: Background photo — strength
fields.name: brg_home_hero_photo_strength
fields.instructions: How strongly the background collage shows, as a percentage. THIS IS USUALLY THE ONE YOU WANT. The hero has always held this photo at 42%, which is most of why it reads as dark; the two vignette settings below only darken what is left. Raise this toward 100 to bring the picture forward. The white headline needs some darkness behind it, so check the headline is still easy to read after a big change.

fields.label: Vignette — middle
fields.name: brg_home_hero_veil_center
fields.instructions: How dark the middle of the hero is, behind the headline, as a percentage. 58 is the value this hero has always used. Lower lets more of the photo through in the middle; higher pushes the picture further back.

fields.label: Vignette — edges
fields.name: brg_home_hero_veil_edge
fields.instructions: How dark the outer edges are, as a percentage. 90 is the value this hero has always used. This is the setting that makes the corners almost black. The darkness fades smoothly between this and the middle value above.

fields.label: Background photo — color
fields.name: brg_home_hero_bg_photo_tone
fields.instructions: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

fields.label: Background photo — movement
fields.name: brg_home_hero_bg_photo_px
fields.instructions: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll, as a percentage of the frame's height. 0 is off. The dropdown this replaces offered 6, 10 and 16 as Subtle, Medium and Strong, so anything already set still reads exactly the same — you can now pick the values in between. 40 is the ceiling: the page itself stops there, so a larger number would do nothing. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

fields.label: Background photo — movement direction
fields.name: brg_home_hero_bg_photo_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: brg_home_hero_video_id
fields.instructions: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank and the photo above is used. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls, and the photo shows while it loads, if the video is blocked, or for visitors who have switched off animation.

fields.label: Video from
fields.name: brg_home_hero_video_source
fields.instructions: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

fields.label: Overlay color
fields.name: brg_home_hero_overlay_color
fields.instructions: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

fields.label: Overlay strength
fields.name: brg_home_hero_overlay_strength
fields.instructions: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.

fields.label: Section background
fields.name: brg_home_hero_section_bg
fields.instructions: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below. ON THE HOME HERO IT IS EFFECTIVELY HIDDEN: the collage is always present and a vignette sits over it, so this layer is behind both. It is here for consistency, not because it will show.

fields.label: Background strength
fields.name: brg_home_hero_section_bg_opacity
fields.instructions: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

fields.label: Background movement
fields.name: brg_home_hero_section_bg_px
fields.instructions: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

fields.label: Background movement direction
fields.name: brg_home_hero_section_bg_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

fields.label: Section background — phones
fields.name: brg_home_hero_section_bg_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.

fields.instructions: How solid the mark is. 100 is as drawn; lower settles it into the background.

fields.label: Button color
fields.name: brg_home_hero_btn_color
fields.instructions: The color for this section's buttons. "As designed" leaves them exactly as they are. Any one button can be given its own color in the list below — this is the one they fall back to.

fields.label: Filled or outline
fields.name: brg_home_hero_btn_style
fields.instructions: Filled is a solid block of color. Outline draws the color as a ring with the words in it and nothing behind. Any one button can be set differently in the list below.

fields.label: Hover effect
fields.name: brg_home_hero_btn_effect
fields.instructions:
What the button does when someone points at it. Lift is what every button has always done and stays the default — it rises slightly and casts a shadow. Lift and swap color does that AND flips to the opposite ink, which is the loudest of the set and best kept for one main action on a page. Underline draws a rule under the words and leaves the button still, which reads as a link — a good fit for the small buttons. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so pair it with Outline. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only; the way the button arrives on screen is the site-wide reveal. Anyone who has switched off animation sees no hover movement whatever is chosen.

fields.label: Buttons
fields.name: brg_home_hero_buttons
fields.instructions:
Buttons for this section. Add as many as you need — they sit in a row and wrap onto the next line on a narrow screen. Leave the list empty, as it is now, and the section has no buttons at all and looks exactly as it does today.

Color and fill are set for the whole section above, and any single button can override them on its own row. Hover is set for the whole section.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: The words on the button. Short reads best: it is set in capitals with wide letter spacing. A button with no label is not drawn.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: href
sub_fields.instructions: Where it goes. A path like /careers/ stays on this site, a full address goes off it, and mailto:someone@blacktoprg.com opens a mail window.

sub_fields.label: Open in a pop-up
sub_fields.name: popup
sub_fields.instructions: For a Google Form, choose Pop-up and it opens in a panel over the page instead of sending people to Google. A form that is set to require a Google sign-in CANNOT be shown this way — Google's sign-in page refuses to be embedded and the panel comes up blank — so that one has to stay on Open the link until its Responses settings are changed. Anything that is not a form stays on Open the link.

sub_fields.label: Color
sub_fields.name: color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" and this button follows the section's color above. Set it to make one button stand out from the others — a main button and a quieter second one, for instance.

sub_fields.label: Filled or outline
sub_fields.name: style
sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" to follow the section. The usual pair is a filled main button next to an outline one.

sub_fields.label: Hover effect
sub_fields.name: effect
sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" and this button follows the section's Hover effect, which in turn follows the site-wide one on the Site-wide page. Set it here to make one button behave differently from its neighbors.

fields.label: Pop-up background
fields.name: brg_home_hero_modal_bg
fields.instructions: The color of the panel a form opens in. Match it to the form's own Theme color in Google Forms and the two read as one surface. This cannot color the form itself — that is Google's page on Google's domain.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_home_community_heading_1
fields.instructions: The section heading. PRESS RETURN to break the line exactly where you want it. The highlighted words are a separate box below, so that the mark can follow them.

fields.label: Heading — before the marked words
fields.name: brg_home_community_heading_2
fields.instructions: The words on the second line that come immediately before the highlighted ones.

fields.label: Heading — the marked words
fields.name: brg_home_community_heading_mark
fields.instructions: The words the highlight sits behind. Keep it short: the mark is drawn to the width of these words, and a long phrase stretches it thin.

fields.label: Intro — before the emphasis
fields.name: brg_home_community_intro_1
fields.instructions: Opening clause, up to the colon. The space before the bold phrase is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
fields.default_value: Blacktop Restaurant Group started with a simple belief:

fields.label: Intro — bold phrase
fields.name: brg_home_community_intro_emphasis
fields.instructions: Rendered bold, mid-sentence. A clause, not a paragraph.
fields.default_value: that a great meal is really just an excuse to connect.

fields.label: Intro — after the emphasis
fields.name: brg_home_community_intro_2
fields.instructions: The rest of the paragraph. Carries the founding year, so it needs editing if that is ever restated.
fields.default_value: Since 2013, we've been growing a family of restaurant brands rooted in genuine hospitality, craft food, and a deep love for the communities we call home.

fields.label: Body copy — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_community_body_1
fields.instructions: Plain text; markup is escaped. Write — as a literal em dash.
fields.default_value: We're not a corporation chasing locations — we're operators who eat at our own restaurants, know our guests by name, and measure success by how many times someone walks out the door smiling.

fields.label: Body copy — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_home_community_body_2
fields.instructions: Carries the live location counts, so it needs editing whenever they change — which is the main reason it is a field. Write & and — as literal characters. CROSS-SECTION FACT — this number also appears in our-restaurants-brands -> Board & Brew second paragraph, and community-stats -> Stat 1 figure. Going ACF-editable REMOVED the check that used to catch a mismatch: it was three greppable strings in the repo, and it is now three database rows that nothing repo-side can compare. If you change one, change all three. (doc strings are per-field by construction, so this warning has to be repeated in each — there is nowhere on this project that can hold a cross-section fact.)
fields.default_value: Today, BRG operates 12 Board & Brew locations across San Diego and Orange County, plus Odie's Pizza Co. in Oceanside — and we're just getting started.

fields.name: brg_home_community_hl_variant
fields.instructions: How the marker highlight behind “for community.” arrives. h3 (default) rough hand-drawn block + ~5deg angled wipe, closest to the comps. h1 background wipe — THE ONLY ONE THAT SURVIVES A LINE WRAP. h0 static, no animation, which is what this mark did before. Unknown or blank renders a static painted mark, never blank. Color and padding are unchanged from the original design. Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Button color

fields.instructions: The color for this section's buttons. "As designed" leaves them exactly as they are. Any one button can be given its own color in the list below — this is the one they fall back to.

fields.label: Filled or outline
fields.name: brg_home_community_btn_style
fields.instructions: Filled is a solid block of color. Outline draws the color as a ring with the words in it and nothing behind. Any one button can be set differently in the list below.

fields.label: Hover effect
fields.name: brg_home_community_btn_effect
fields.instructions:
What the button does when someone points at it. Lift is what every button has always done and stays the default — it rises slightly and casts a shadow. Lift and swap color does that AND flips to the opposite ink, which is the loudest of the set and best kept for one main action on a page. Underline draws a rule under the words and leaves the button still, which reads as a link — a good fit for the small buttons. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so pair it with Outline. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only; the way the button arrives on screen is the site-wide reveal. Anyone who has switched off animation sees no hover movement whatever is chosen.

fields.label: Buttons
fields.name: brg_home_community_buttons
fields.instructions:
Buttons for this section. Add as many as you need — they sit in a row and wrap onto the next line on a narrow screen. Leave the list empty, as it is now, and the section has no buttons at all and looks exactly as it does today.

Color and fill are set for the whole section above, and any single button can override them on its own row. Hover is set for the whole section.

sub_fields.label: Label

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: href
sub_fields.instructions: Where it goes. A path like /careers/ stays on this site, a full address goes off it, and mailto:someone@blacktoprg.com opens a mail window.

sub_fields.label: Open in a pop-up
sub_fields.name: popup
sub_fields.instructions: For a Google Form, choose Pop-up and it opens in a panel over the page instead of sending people to Google. A form that is set to require a Google sign-in CANNOT be shown this way — Google's sign-in page refuses to be embedded and the panel comes up blank — so that one has to stay on Open the link until its Responses settings are changed. Anything that is not a form stays on Open the link.

sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" and this button follows the section's Hover effect, which in turn follows the site-wide one on the Site-wide page. Set it here to make one button behave differently from its neighbors.

fields.label: Pop-up background
fields.name: brg_home_different_modal_bg
fields.instructions: The color of the panel a form opens in. Match it to the form's own Theme color in Google Forms and the two read as one surface. This cannot color the form itself — that is Google's page on Google's domain.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_home_values_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Show the divider icon
fields.name: brg_home_values_show_divider
fields.instructions: The round badge that sits between this section and the one above it. Untick to remove just the badge — the section itself stays.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_home_values_heading
fields.instructions: Sits above the values grid, in the display face. Plain — no marker block, no line break. ~24 characters.

fields.label: Section background
fields.name: brg_home_values_section_bg
fields.instructions: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below.

fields.label: Background strength
fields.name: brg_home_values_section_bg_opacity
fields.instructions: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

fields.label: Background movement
fields.name: brg_home_values_section_bg_px
fields.instructions: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

fields.label: Background movement direction
fields.name: brg_home_values_section_bg_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

fields.label: Section background — phones
fields.name: brg_home_values_section_bg_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.

fields.label: The values
fields.name: brg_home_values_values
fields.instructions:
The cards in this section. They were built into the page and could not be edited.

UNTIL YOU ADD THE FIRST ONE HERE the page keeps showing the five it has always shown — Leadership, Culture, Advocate, Stay Stoked, Community. Adding one replaces all five, so add every card you want, not only the one you are changing.

The grid reflows to whatever number you give it.

sub_fields.label: Name
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: The short name on the card, set in the brand face. One or two words reads best.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: body
sub_fields.instructions: The sentence or two underneath. Write an em dash as a literal character, not as an entity.

fields.label: Artwork
fields.name: brg_home_values_mark_1_ast_art
fields.instructions: Which mark is drawn here. Leave it alone to keep the one the design uses. Any SVG or PNG from the media library works; SVG stays crisp at any size.

fields.label: Position
fields.name: brg_home_values_mark_1_ast_pos
fields.instructions: Where the mark sits in its section. "Where the design put it" is the starting point and leaves it exactly where it is now — choose one of the nine only when you want to move it. Corners sit inside the section padding, so a long headline cannot push a mark down into the type.

fields.label: Opacity
fields.name: brg_home_values_mark_1_ast_opacity
fields.instructions: How solid the mark is. 100 is as drawn; lower settles it into the background.

fields.label: Show this mark
fields.name: brg_home_values_mark_1_ast_show
fields.instructions: Hiding removes just this one mark. Nothing else in the section changes.

fields.label: Animation
fields.name: brg_home_values_mark_1_ast_anim
fields.instructions: How the mark moves. "As built" keeps what it does today — a hard-cut jitter for most, a spin for the asterisk in the hero cluster. Still stops it entirely. Anyone who has switched off animation in their system settings sees it still whatever is chosen here.

fields.label: Where the buttons sit
fields.name: brg_home_values_cta_position
fields.instructions: At the bottom is the usual place and the one the rest of the site uses.

choices.foot: At the bottom of the section
choices.head: Directly under the heading

fields.label: Button color
fields.name: brg_home_values_btn_color
fields.instructions: The color for this section's buttons. "As designed" leaves them exactly as they are. Any one button can be given its own color in the list below — this is the one they fall back to.

fields.label: Filled or outline
fields.name: brg_home_values_btn_style
fields.instructions: Filled is a solid block of color. Outline draws the color as a ring with the words in it and nothing behind. Any one button can be set differently in the list below.

fields.label: Hover effect
fields.name: brg_home_values_btn_effect
fields.instructions:
What the button does when someone points at it. Lift is what every button has always done and stays the default — it rises slightly and casts a shadow. Lift and swap color does that AND flips to the opposite ink, which is the loudest of the set and best kept for one main action on a page. Underline draws a rule under the words and leaves the button still, which reads as a link — a good fit for the small buttons. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so pair it with Outline. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only; the way the button arrives on screen is the site-wide reveal. Anyone who has switched off animation sees no hover movement whatever is chosen.

fields.label: Buttons
fields.name: brg_home_values_buttons
fields.instructions:
Buttons for this section. Add as many as you need — they sit in a row and wrap onto the next line on a narrow screen. Leave the list empty, as it is now, and the section has no buttons at all and looks exactly as it does today.

Color and fill are set for the whole section above, and any single button can override them on its own row. Hover is set for the whole section.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: The words on the button. Short reads best: it is set in capitals with wide letter spacing. A button with no label is not drawn.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: href
sub_fields.instructions: Where it goes. A path like /careers/ stays on this site, a full address goes off it, and mailto:someone@blacktoprg.com opens a mail window.

sub_fields.label: Open in a pop-up
sub_fields.name: popup
sub_fields.instructions: For a Google Form, choose Pop-up and it opens in a panel over the page instead of sending people to Google. A form that is set to require a Google sign-in CANNOT be shown this way — Google's sign-in page refuses to be embedded and the panel comes up blank — so that one has to stay on Open the link until its Responses settings are changed. Anything that is not a form stays on Open the link.

sub_fields.label: Color
sub_fields.name: color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" and this button follows the section's color above. Set it to make one button stand out from the others — a main button and a quieter second one, for instance.

sub_fields.label: Filled or outline
sub_fields.name: style
sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" to follow the section. The usual pair is a filled main button next to an outline one.

sub_fields.label: Hover effect
sub_fields.name: effect
sub_fields.instructions: Leave on "Same as the section" and this button follows the section's Hover effect, which in turn follows the site-wide one on the Site-wide page. Set it here to make one button behave differently from its neighbors.

fields.label: Pop-up background
fields.name: brg_home_values_modal_bg
fields.instructions: The color of the panel a form opens in. Match it to the form's own Theme color in Google Forms and the two read as one surface. This cannot color the form itself — that is Google's page on Google's domain.

description: Editable content for the Home page, one tab per section. Generated — edit website/sections/<id>/slots.json and rerun kit/build-acf.py.
